messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — change window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC (UTC). Planned rolling canary for service-api v4.2.3. Need pin approvals, rollback owners, and a short launch checklist.

carla: :thumbsup: I can approve the infra pin. Will watch redis and connection pool.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy: v4.2.3 -> canary (staging) at 2024-06-08T02:15:00Z. ID DPL-2918. Healthchecks: enabled.

ben: I'm oncall for the window. Rollback owner for this rollout. Trigger rollback if p95 latency > 1.5x baseline or error rate > 2% for 5m.

alice: Thanks — noted @ben. Erin will post release notes link. Also adding the checklist below so everyone knows responsibilities.

erin: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v4.2.3 (draft). Highlights: batching perf fixes, kvcache reuse, and compatibility with quantized kernels.

dmitri: Smoke test runbook updated: `scripts/smoke_canary.sh` (runs sample prompts, embedding checks, and a quick perf profile). I will run it immediately after canary is up.

alice: Launch checklist (short):
- pin model/service version in deploy-config (alice/carla)
- deploy canary to 3% of hosts (deploy-bot)
- run `scripts/smoke_canary.sh` (dmitri)
- watch SLOs and dashboards (ben/car|dmitri)
- ramp traffic 10 -> 50 -> 100 over 15-30m if healthy (deploy-bot + carla)
- rollback if fail criteria met (ben)

carla: Pin applied to infra routes: `service-api@v4.2.3` (flagged pinned by carla).

ben: Quick decision rule: immediate rollback if any of these are true:
- total errors > 2% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m
- memory OOMs on >1 host
I'll call the rollback and coordinate with oncall.

alice: Rollback procedure reminder: unpin v4.2.3, re-pin v4.2.2, run canary-smoke on v4.2.2, and open rollback PR (PR-5872). Notify #incidents and #customer-success.

deploy-bot: DPL-2918: canary instances started (3 hosts). Running health checks.

dmitri: Healthcheck logs snippet:
```
[2024-06-08T02:17:22Z] healthcheck.ok backend_samples: 120/120
[2024-06-08T02:18:10Z] smoke.all_passed latency.mean=42ms p95=120ms
```

deploy-bot: DPL-2918: healthchecks passed (5m). Ready for traffic ramp. Use commands: `deploy-bot shift --id DPL-2918 --percent 10` then `--percent 50`.

carla: Kicking off ramp to 10% now, holding 10m for metrics.

ben: Monitoring. If anything weird, I'll flip the roll button.

alice: Also reminder about freeze: strict code freeze starts 01:30 UTC until 04:30 UTC. No hotfixes unless emergency-approved by eng-sre and product.

erin: Noting customer comms: send short note if ramp hits >30% errors or sustained latency regressions.

carla: :white_check_mark: 10% hold complete, errors 0.1%, p95 stable. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: DPL-2918: traffic shifted to 50%. Monitoring window open.

dmitri: Running extended smoke and perf probe (10m). Logs look clean so far.

ben: All good on my side. No rollback. I’ll stay until 04:30 UTC just in case.

alice: Great work team — will post final go/no-go summary after 30m ramp. If we stay green, we’ll finish the rollout and update release notes to final. :rocket:
